candidates.change_summary: Replace body of withdrawAll to transfer zero instead of current balance, changing post-call contract balance and thus observable behavior.
Replace transfer to send (returns bool instead of reverting) so withdraw may silently fail and change observed post-withdraw balance.
Remove the require check so any caller can invoke withdraw, changing who can withdraw and thus observed balance after withdraw.
Replace the low-level call to instead perform a call with value 0 (so sendMoney no longer forwards the requested _value).
Replace the low-level call with a simple transfer to the target ignoring _data (so behavior and forwarded data differ).
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), which lets non-owners call sendMoney and thus can change observed outcomes.
